svg.title: Corrosion Causes - Flow Diagram
svg.desc: Key: 高温 = high temperature; 高Cl⁻ = elevated chloride; CO₂/H₂S = carbon dioxide/hydrogen sulphide; 溶解O₂ = dissolved oxygen; 微生物 = microorganisms; 结垢 = scale; 电化学反应 = electrochemical reaction; 钝化膜破坏 = passive-film damage; 提供H⁺ = hydrogen-ion supply; 氧去极化腐蚀 = oxygen-depolarisation corrosion; 代谢产酸/硫化物 = metabolic acids/sulphides; 垢下腐蚀 = under-deposit corrosion; 腐蚀速率增加 = increased corrosion rate; 金属腐蚀/设备失效 = metal corrosion/equipment failure.
